checking: Checking the automatic host ID migration.
commit_unconfirmed: The code installation has not been confirmed by the launcher yet. The data was not converted; check the update state before restarting.
completed: Automatic ID migration completed and verified.
converting: Converting the host identities automatically. Please wait; edits and interactive connections are temporarily blocked.
preflight_blocked: Automatic ID migration blocked in the pre-check ({count} problem(s)). No orphan reference was deleted. Fix the data reported by the dry-run and restart to try again.
read_only: Read-only mode: automatic migration not run.
recovery_failed: Could not complete or recover the automatic ID migration. Edits are blocked to preserve the data. The baseline and the journal were kept; check the recovery before restarting.
waiting_commit: Waiting for the launcher to confirm the installation before converting the host IDs.
